name: p4-scratchpad
description: Keeps the notebook in <project>/.claude/p4/scratchpad/ and the session temp directory in <project>/.claude/p4/tmp/<session>/: the session start links the harness scratchpad there, re-seeds the notebook ignored .out/ and sweeps logs, build results and binaries into it. Two asks about where code belongs ship off; P4_SCRATCHPAD_ASKS=1 turns them on.
